structured_output.summary: Implements Math.random with a SplitMix64 generator held in a process-wide static AtomicU64, seeded once from std's RandomState. Each call takes the top 53 bits and scales by 2^-53, so the result is in [0, 1) with positive sign, which matches the spec text. The shared static means every realm's Math.random advances one sequence, so distinct realms never replay the same values. There are no test-specific branches, no swallowed errors, and no observable steps (the spec has none). The existing spec-step comments are kept above the code.
